title: Hearing on NYC school bus transportation services
summary: The Council's Education Committee held an oversight hearing examining problems with New York City's school bus system, including contracting, labor disputes and service reliability. The hearing also covered a bill to create a public school bus performance dashboard and a resolution urging Albany to pass legislation on employee protections in bus transportation contracts. Background includes the Panel for Educational Policy's November 2025 approval of $5.4 billion in three-year bus vendor contracts running through June 2028.
